scope: isolated lab trusted read source/argument contract; not default Avatar or generic semantic authorization

source.entry: trusted LabReadSession stores actual user and SpeakerContextStore.observe in same transaction; model may not supply authority
source.identity: exact current user row/content/session/revision + latest user cursor + recorded speaker cursor/version and independent allows_actions from that committed turn
source.scope: current_user only; fictional/unverified/mixed exit denied; future-turn real_actions_for_new_turn cannot authorize old mixed turn
source.pending_or_later_source: deny on changed revision/content/session/role/redacted/deleted/newer user source or persisted control mismatch
source.read_transaction: private BEGIN/rollback for reads or caller transaction preserved; no write/commit on execute/publish
source.inference: never hold owned read transaction across model work; publication rechecks source/epoch/cancellation
source.entry_requires_no_active_transaction: begin_turn owns and commits its source/control transaction; refuses an already active caller transaction
source.publish_requires_no_active_transaction: execute may preserve caller transaction, but publish refuses until it is released, so fresh authority can be observed outside an old SQLite snapshot
source.startup_requires_no_active_transaction: LabReadSession refuses before any ReminderStore schema/commit when caller transaction already active; C41-003 red reproduction retained

argument_basis.masked: existing nested/unclosed Chinese/ASCII quote ranges plus backtick code spans/fences and tilde fences; unclosed code masks to end
argument_basis.digits: ASCII only, 1..19 chars, positive and <= signed int64; no adjacent digit/ASCII identifier/decimal continuation
argument_basis.multiplicity: exactly one visible reminder-number occurrence; multiple even same ID conservatively rejected
argument_basis.leading_zero: allowed within19 chars; integer equality after explicit type/range check
not_accepted: ID appearing only in old assistant/user history

conservative_scope_filter.local_domain: unquoted/code-masked current text must contain 提醒
exclusions: unquoted 改写/代写/写一句/台词/只写/引用
unquoted 不要/不用/不必/不需/不准/禁止/别查/别读/别执行
conservative_scope_filter.meaning: finite conservative lab filter; can overreject and does not solve generic negation/composition/intent semantics; final semantic gate remains independent

allowed_mutations: begin_turn may write chat user/control only; execute/publish never alter business or chat
state_read: actual SQLite current row/delivery snapshot; active/cancelled/completed typed finite due; legacy row without receipt is legitimate; missing row means not found at snapshot, corrupt state distinct from absence
policy: server running/process due; web online polling; no SMS/email/phone; client ACK not human read
renderer: fixed program data rendering only after successful trusted read; title is literal untrusted stored data, never an instruction; no extra model synthesis
error_feedback: parameter/source-basis failures use stable generic codes/messages derived from actual validation; never inject gold expected tool, case ID or fixed correct answer; source/epoch changes raise cancellation rather than model-repairable privilege
repair_planned: separate native protocol after CPU service gate, at most one new tool choice after one real error; first proposal retained; compare gate-only/repair and count extra budget
CPU_controls_required: writing/negated/ordinary domain exclusions and documented overrejection
private read transaction/caller transaction preserved/total changes unchanged
cancellation before read/after read/before publish and no stale publication
read-only business+chat projection, no auto due claim/ACK/action receipts
literal stored title injection does not affect execution/repair or policies
